controls.label: GetPreviewFrameAsync
controls.expected: Captures a preview frame from the running camera preview. Disabled until the camera preview is started; with no camera hardware it stays disabled.

controls.label: Show frame
controls.expected: Toggles whether the captured preview frame is displayed in the image control.

controls.label: Green effect
controls.expected: Toggles a software green tint applied to the captured frame.

controls.label: Save frame
controls.expected: Toggles whether the captured frame is saved to a file.

actions.expectedResponse: Updates the preview/frame image and FrameInfo text when a camera is present. Hardware-gated: with no camera the button is disabled and produces no response.
